claims.text: Bowie House is at 3700 Camp Bowie Boulevard in Fort Worth's Cultural District, near the city's museums, Will Rogers Memorial Center and Dickies Arena.

findings.quote: Bowie House is located at 3700 Camp Bowie Boulevard in Fort Worth’s Cultural District, near the city’s renowned museums, Will Rogers Memorial Center and Dickies Arena.

claims.text: The hotel merges the classic Western personality of Texas with a decidedly modern feel.

findings.quote: Bowie House merges the classic Western personality of Texas with a decidedly modern feel

claims.text: Owner Jo Ellard, who breeds championship horses at her ranch outside Fort Worth, teamed up with Dallas-based BOKA Powell to design and furnish the hotel.

findings.quote: it is owned by the incredibly badass businesswoman Jo Ellard who breeds championship horses at her ranch outside of Fort Worth
She teamed up with Dallas-based BOKA Powell to design and furnish the place

claims.text: All guest rooms feature personalized bar carts, lounge spaces and original artwork.

findings.quote: all guest rooms feature luxe amenities like personalized bar carts, lounge spaces and original artwork

claims.text: Balcony Studios have a private balcony for morning coffee outdoors.

findings.quote: sleep in our Balcony Studios to enjoy your morning coffee outdoors on your own private balcony

claims.text: The Goodnight Suite has a living room, a dining room and a bedroom with a king size bed.

findings.quote: The Goodnight Suite is the crème de la crème of the property spanning almost 2,000 square feet and featuring a living room, dining room, and a bedroom with a king size bed.

claims.text: Ash Spa is a full-service spa with massages, facials and wellness treatments, an infrared sauna, a steam room and a relaxation lounge.

findings.quote: Ash, an Auberge Spa, is a full-service spa offering massages, facials and innovative wellness treatments alongside an infrared sauna, steam room and relaxation lounge.

claims.text: Ash Spa has a couples' suite with a private shower.

findings.quote: Enjoy the ultimate wellness experience for two in our beautiful couples' suite, featuring a private shower.

claims.text: Bricks and Horses is the hotel's signature indoor-outdoor restaurant, pairing down-home Texas cuisine with city sophistication.

findings.quote: Down-home Texas cuisine meets city sophistication at our signature indoor-outdoor restaurant, Bricks and Horses.

claims.text: The Mulberry Room is the hotel's library, with a large bourbon collection and monthly gatherings.

findings.quote: The Mulberry Room is Bowie House’s cozy library
Visit the Mulberry Room for monthly gatherings, or teach yourself more about bourbon with our vast collection

claims.text: The Billet Room hosts weekly game leagues, from cowboy bingo to billiards tournaments.

findings.quote: Join us weekly to compete in your favorite game leagues
Join us to compete in your favorite game leagues, from cowboy bingo to exhilarating billiards tournaments

claims.text: Cribs, highchairs, children's menus and third-party babysitting are available.

findings.quote: there are crib and highchairs available, children’s menus at the hotel’s restaurant, and babysitting services that can be arranged through a third party

claims.text: The hotel is filled with works of art personally collected by owner Jo Ellard, and a complimentary art walk showcases the collection.

findings.quote: Bowie House is filled with more than 400 works of art—all personally collected by Ellard herself.
this complimentary art walk showcases 400 pieces collected over 20 years by the hotel’s owner and visionary Jo Ellard

claims.text: A second-floor outdoor terrace pool is surrounded by garden views, with private cabanas and poolside dining and drinks from Whinny's.

findings.quote: Bowie House has a second-floor outdoor terrace pool surrounded by garden views, with chaises, private cabanas and poolside dining and drinks from Whinny’s.

claims.text: Ash, an Auberge Spa, sits on the hotel's second floor and is inspired by the barns of Texas.

findings.quote: Ash, an Auberge Spa, is a serene sanctuary on the hotel's second floor, inspired by the ubiquitous barns of Texas.

claims.text: Each Studio nods to Texas living with hat racks, boot benches, boot jacks and leather-wrapped furniture; Lofts and Suites add touches such as pantries, powder rooms, free-standing soaking tubs and even a fireplace.

findings.quote: each Studio features a rich interior color palette and nods to Texas living with features like hat racks, boot benches, boot jacks and leather wrapped furniture
familiar Texas touches meet luxe additions like bar carts, pantries, powder rooms, free-standing soaking tubs and even a fireplace

claims.text: The centerpiece of The Bar at Bowie House is a vintage bar Ellard sourced from an auction house in Waco, Texas.

findings.quote: The Bar at Bowie House’s centerpiece is a dramatic vintage bar Ellard sourced from an auction house in Waco, Texas.

claims.text: Bowie House is approximately 28 miles, or 35-40 minutes, from Dallas Fort Worth International Airport.

findings.quote: Bowie House is approximately 28 miles, or 35-40 minutes, from Dallas Fort Worth International Airport.

claims.text: The Fort Worth Stockyards are not on the doorstep; they are approximately four miles away.

findings.quote: The Fort Worth Stockyards are approximately four miles away.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes limited parking availability.
